name: Optimisarr
description: Optimisarr optimises video, audio and image libraries with FFmpeg and verifies candidates before replacing originals. Configured checks cover decoding, timing, retained streams, metadata, size savings and media quality, including VMAF for video. Originals are quarantined for rollback until approved or purged by the configured retention policy. Run CPU, Intel QSV/VA-API or NVIDIA NVENC jobs in the container, or pair Windows, macOS and Linux sidecars for distributed video encoding and verification. Integrates with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Sonarr and Radarr. The web UI shows libraries, queued work, quality reports and savings. Mount one read-write storage root at /data for media, work and quarantine. Review a small test set before enabling automatic replacement.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent application state: SQLite database and configuration. Keep on fast storage.

paths.name: Storage root
paths.description: One read-write root for your media, temporary output, and quarantine. Keeping them below one container mapping preserves atomic moves.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Optimisarr web interface (container listens on 8787).

variables.name: Work directory
variables.description: Temporary transcode output inside the storage root. A separate fast-scratch mount requires the verified cross-filesystem fallback.

variables.name: Quarantine directory
variables.description: Rollback originals inside the storage root so replacements can use atomic moves.

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Optional. When set, the administrative API and UI require this bearer token. Leave blank to rely on your network/reverse-proxy for access control.

variables.name: Remote workers
variables.description: Remote workers are available by default. Set false to disable the worker service for this deployment. Existing saved settings are preserved; pair trusted sidecars in Settings → Remote workers and choose work placement per library.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid 'nobody' is 99). Files it creates use this owner.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid 'users' is 100).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permissions mask for files Optimisarr creates.

devices.name: Intel/AMD GPU (/dev/dri)
devices.description: Optional. Map the render node for Intel QSV/VA-API or AMD VA-API hardware transcoding. Remove if the host has no /dev/dri. For NVIDIA NVENC, add '--runtime=nvidia' and the NVIDIA_* variables via Extra Parameters instead (see the setup guide).
